items.prompt:
Which sentence is an opinion?

A) The sky is blue.
B) I think the sky is the prettiest color.
items.answer: B) I think the sky is the prettiest color.

steps: An opinion expresses what someone thinks or believes. 'I think the sky is the prettiest color' uses the opinion word 'I think.' The sky being blue is a fact.

items.prompt:
Which word connects an opinion to its reason?

A) and
B) because

steps: 'Because' introduces the reason that supports an opinion. 'And' just connects two ideas of equal weight.

items.prompt:
Which sentence has both an opinion AND a reason?

A) I think cats are great.
B) I think cats are great because they are soft and quiet.
items.answer: B) I think cats are great because they are soft and quiet.

steps: Sentence A has the opinion but no reason. Sentence B has the opinion ('cats are great') and a reason ('because they are soft and quiet').

items.prompt: A student writes: 'I believe we should have more library time. Books help us learn new words and ideas. That is why more library time is a great idea.' Identify the opinion sentence, the reason sentence, and the closing sentence.
items.answer: Opinion: 'I believe we should have more library time.' Reason: 'Books help us learn new words and ideas.' Closing: 'That is why more library time is a great idea.'

steps: The opinion sentence starts with 'I believe' and states the main idea.
The reason sentence explains why with a specific benefit.
The closing restates the idea and signals the end.

items.prompt:
Which is a stronger reason for the opinion 'I think students should drink more water at school'?

A) Water is wet.
B) Drinking water helps students stay focused and feel less tired.
items.answer: B) Drinking water helps students stay focused and feel less tired.

steps: A strong reason explains a specific benefit. 'Water is wet' is just a fact about water. 'Helps students stay focused and feel less tired' explains why drinking water matters at school.

items.prompt:
Which closing sentence best wraps up this opinion paragraph?

'I think every student should learn to draw. Drawing helps you be creative and notice details.'

A) Drawing takes a long time.
B) That is why drawing is an important skill for all students to learn.
items.answer: B) That is why drawing is an important skill for all students to learn.

steps: A closing sentence restates the opinion and signals the end of the paragraph. Sentence B does this by calling drawing 'an important skill.' Sentence A introduces an unrelated idea.

items.prompt: Write a complete 3-sentence opinion paragraph about whether students should be allowed to listen to music while they work. Include an opinion, one reason, and a closing sentence.
items.answer: I think students should be allowed to listen to quiet music while they work because it helps them focus and feel calm. When students are calm, they do better on their assignments. That is why soft music should be allowed during work time.

steps: Sentence 1: 'I think students should be allowed to listen to music because...'
Sentence 2: expand on the reason or show a benefit.
Sentence 3: closing sentence that restates the opinion.

items.prompt:
Read this paragraph and explain what is missing. Then fix it.

'I think we should have more field trips. Field trips are fun. The end.'
items.answer: The paragraph is missing a strong reason and a proper closing sentence. Fixed: 'I think we should have more field trips because they help students learn about the real world outside of school. Seeing new places makes learning exciting and memorable. That is why more field trips would benefit every student.'

steps: 'Field trips are fun' is a weak reason. Add a specific benefit: 'they help students learn about the real world.'
'The end' is not a real closing sentence. Replace with 'That is why more field trips would benefit every student.'
